name: routine-failed-item
description: The run completes but its single item FAILED (status 'failed', an error object instead of a result). Clay charges nothing for a failed item, so every line settles 0 — including mobile-phone's miss lines: a failure is not an exhausted waterfall. NOT recorded live (no way to provoke a failure through the public surface at port time); the envelope is the shape v1's provider tests pinned, on the chain the live recordings prove.
